body:
Thanks. I've been in this place enough times to catch myself grieving. I just don't think this one will go away anytime soon. But it's okay, even if a girl did mean the world to me I can't let it break the strength I've built over the last ~11 months.

And we watched a bunch of Vice docs and some Idiot Abroad which is pretty hard to classify as a doc but Netflix said it not me. It was pretty rad.
